deterministic_defect.contract_goal: Slice 7 Goal states crash/retry must not duplicate or widen terminal execution, and Included scope states crash representation after adapter success/before response.
deterministic_defect.implementation_order: The reference executor invokes adapter(binding) while the SQLite transaction is open, then constructs completion evidence, writes status=COMPLETED, and only then commits SQLite.
deterministic_defect.uncovered_window: A process death after the adapter side effect succeeds but before the SQLite COMPLETED update/commit rolls back the local IN_PROGRESS transaction while leaving any nontransactional adapter side effect outside SQLite intact.
deterministic_defect.retry_consequence: After reopen, no durable completed row proves the prior side effect occurred, so exact retry may invoke the adapter again and duplicate the terminal action.
deterministic_defect.test_gap: S7-13 injects crash only after the COMPLETED row has already been durably committed. It does not test adapter-success-before-ledger-commit.

root_cause_classification: CODE DEFECT + ACCEPTANCE-COVERAGE DEFECT UNDER BROAD FROZEN CRASH CLAIM
scientific_effect: The first green S7-01..S7-21 run remains preserved but is false-green with respect to the broader crash/retry claim. It remains valid only for the explicitly exercised post-durable-record crash point.

remediation_options.option_a: Narrow the Slice 7 crash claim to exclude a nontransactional adapter-success-before-ledger-commit window. Keep production/remote exactly-once execution explicitly untested.
remediation_options.option_b: Keep the broad crash/retry non-amplification goal. Require the terminal adapter itself to accept terminal_execution_id as a durable idempotency key and expose a recover/query-by-idempotency mechanism (or equivalent transactional protocol). Add a frozen crash case after adapter effect but before local completion commit; retry must recover/converge without applying the adapter effect twice.

recommendation_reason: A terminal executor is exactly where irreversible side effects occur. Narrowing away the most dangerous crash window would leave the principal operational failure mode ungoverned. Provider/model/CI success cannot compensate for that gap.
promotion_rule: Do not merge PR #16. Resolve the authority-freshness requirement and this crash-atomicity boundary, amend/freeze the contract, expose the new case before mechanism repair, repair without weakening the case, requalify a new exact candidate, and obtain fresh independent review plus deterministic review-of-review.
